package.description: CLI for running large numbers of coding agents in parallel with git worktrees

en-US.description: CLI for running large numbers of coding agents in parallel with git worktrees
en-US.longDescription:
CLI for running large numbers of coding agents in parallel with git worktrees
Features
- 🤖 Run multiple AI coding agents in parallel
- 🌳 Automatic Git worktree management for isolated development
- 🖥️ Tmux session management for each agent
- 🚀 Automatic development server setup with port management
- 📊 Real-time monitoring of agent status and code changes
- 🔄 Automatic handling of agent prompts and confirmations
- 🎯 Easy checkpoint and merge of agent changes
en-US.name: Uzi

zh-CN.description: 用于并行运行大量编码代理的 CLI，支持 Git 工作树
zh-CN.longDescription:
用于并行运行大量编码代理的 CLI，支持 Git 工作树
功能
- 🤖 并行运行多个 AI 编码代理
- 🌳 自动化 Git 工作树管理，实现隔离开发
- 🖥️ 为每个代理管理 Tmux 会话
- 🚀 自动配置开发服务器并管理端口
- 📊 实时监控代理状态和代码变更
- 🔄 自动处理代理的提示和确认操作
- 🎯 方便地检查点和合并代理的更改
